sites.source: https://wvdnr.gov/lands-waters/wildlife-management-areas/district-4-wildlife-management-areas/ ('57. Plum Orchard Lake ... On the WMA: ... campsites – 21 rustic'), read 2026-10-21

note: WV DNR rustic campground at Plum Orchard Lake Wildlife Management Area near Oak Hill and Scarbro (Fayette County), by the dam, office and boat ramp of a 200-acre fishing lake. Shooting range and hiking trails on the WMA. --Claude
summary: WV DNR District 4 page confirms 21 rustic campsites (sites now manual), a 175-yard shooting range and hiking trails; the DNR map labels the campground. Phone (304) 469-9905 matches the page. Not stated: fees, reservations, season, toilets, rig size, hookups (derived electric 0 left). Note trimmed of the site count and hookups restatements.
flags: Criteria: DNR says only 'campsites – 21 rustic'; no page gives a site length or says a 23-ft motorhome fits. No fee, season or booking information on any DNR page.
